svg.title: October Fed hold and hike rows on Kalshi and Polymarket, September 29 and 30, 2026
svg.desc: Direct event-page observations: Kalshi hold rose 52 to 65 percent and 25 basis point hike fell 46 to 35; Polymarket no change rose 51 to 66 and 25 basis point increase fell 48 to 34. September 29 at 19:02 UTC versus September 30 at 13:36 UTC. Access times are not quote timestamps.
svg.text: October decision rows: hold extends its lead
Named event-page rows · September 29, 19:02 UTC → September 30, 13:36 UTC
Sources: direct Kalshi and Polymarket October event pages; each bar = a named rounded row.
Light = September 29; dark = September 30. Page access time, not quote time.
